identitySignals: Organization's own site (scientificadventures.org) names it 'Scientific Adventures for Girls', based in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda's name and location
Site describes afterschool and summer STEM programs for TK-6th graders, matching OUSD's 'After-school & summer programs' and 'Classroom & academic programs' contracts
Site states 501(c)(3) Tax ID 47-2414936, and ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists EIN 47-2414936 as 'Scientific Adventures' in Oakland, CA, a 501(c)(3) for educational and scientific purposes
research.notes: IRS/ProPublica lists the legal name as 'Scientific Adventures'; 'Scientific Adventures for Girls' is the name used on the website and in the agenda (likely a doing-business-as name). CA Secretary of State and SAM.gov were not checked (web search budget exhausted).

profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs afterschool STEM (science, technology, engineering and math) programs for students in transitional kindergarten through 6th grade, with a focus on girls of color from low-income families. Its programs include afterschool classes, summer camps, family events, library programs and a scholar club in the San Francisco East Bay area.

review.notes: Org site (Oakland, CA; TK-6 afterschool/summer STEM) matches the agenda name and OUSD services, and its EIN 47-2414936 matches ProPublica's 501(c)(3) listing for Scientific Adventures in Oakland. Summary, contact fields and EIN are supported by the cited pages and the summary is neutral.
